texto: The five tones are **medio**, **bajo**, **descendente**, **alto** and **ascendente**. There are four graphic signs of tone: **่**, **้**, **๊** and **๋**. The sign does not always give the same tone on its own: it also matters the class of the initial consonant.

bloques.titulo: He was alive and he was dead.
texto: A syllable is usually **viva** if it ends in long vocal or in a continuous sound like m, n or ng. It is usually **muerta** if it ends in short vowel or in a p, t or k closure. In the low consonants, dead syllables also distinguish the short vocal from the long. Don't deduke the tone by looking at the sign alone.

**ไก่** (chicken) and **ไข่** (egg) share the **่** sign, but the initial consonant belongs to another class and changes the tone. **ไหม** (question particle) and **ไม่** (no) are written almost the same: it changes the sign and changes the tone and meaning. Writing and tone avoid confusing them.

intro: The Thai has five spoken tones. The initial consonant, the shape of the syllable, the duration of the vowel and the tone signs work together. Learn first to recognize them; the complete rules are gradually dominated.
